name: durable-mutation-drops-transient-pairing
body:
Bug + root cause [verified against this branch's code, v0.12.0 / main f81aafe].

Symptom: a durable node/edge mutation (`apg node update` / `apg edge …`) drops every transient `Feedback-[:Reviews]->node` edge incident to a changed FQN from `db.lbug`, until some later transient review write re-projects it. `apg review list` can then hide an open item, and the verify gate's "all feedback resolved" / feedback-attachment checks are skewed.

Root cause: the durable mutation projects the durable `apg/layers/` tree ONLY.
- `apg.layers.write_project_with` (src/layers.rs:2140) step 6 (line 2210) builds its record set with `apg.layers.ingest_tree` — which walks the durable tree and never the transient plan/feedback mirrors — and applies `apg.layers.projection_deletes` (src/layers.rs:2080) = changed ∪ removed FQNs.
- `apg.artifacts.ArtifactDb.reingest_layers_on` (src/artifacts.rs:1243) runs `detach_delete_project` (DETACH) over exactly that FQN set — so the changed node's incident `Feedback-[:Reviews]` edge is removed while the `Feedback` node survives — then re-merges only the durable records; the transient half is never restored.
- The transient path does NOT have this defect: `apg.artifacts.write_jsonl_and_reingest` (src/artifacts.rs:165) reassembles ALL six transient files via `apg.artifacts.assembled_records` (src/artifacts.rs:1064) before the apply, restoring the pairing.
- A full `apg scan` pairs them correctly — test `apg.layers.tests.scan_ingests_transient_plans_and_feedback_paired_to_durable_nodes` (src/layers.rs:4834).

Fix direction: the durable projection apply must also re-merge the assembled transient records (or otherwise not drop transient pairings incident to changed FQNs). Anchored to `requirements.requirement.durable-mutation-preserves-transient-pairing` and `solution.component.durable-projection-transient-remerge`.
